5 rounds for time of:
* **Dumbbell Split Cleans**: 15
* **Pull-ups**: 21

♀ 25-lb dumbbells
♂ 40-lb dumbbells
section_notes: This is a Hero WOD and should be quick; avoid letting it become a long slog.
Reduce weight and reps on split cleans to keep moving.
Modify pull-ups so each round is completed in 3 or 4 sets.

metadata.raw_content:
**Erin**

5 rounds for time of:  
15 dumbbell split cleans  
21 [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kipping-pull-up)

♀ 25-lb dumbbells  
♂ 40-lb dumbbells

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/240202).

Compare to [180719](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2018/07/19#/comments).

_Canadian Army Master Corporal Erin Doyle, 32, was killed in a firefight Aug. 11, 2008, in the Panjwaii District, Kandahar Province, Afghanistan. He is survived by his wife Nicole and his daughter Zarine._

**Scaling:**  
Today’s workout is a Hero. Compared to other Hero WODs, this is quick and should not be drawn out into a long slog. To keep moving, reduce the weight and reps on the split cleans. Modify the pull-ups so each round can be completed in 3 or 4 sets.

metadata.raw_content:
**Christine**

500-meter [row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing?utm_source=owned&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=mswod)

**Scaling:**  
Today’s workout is a classic CrossFit benchmark. For an advanced athlete, each round is a sprint. Put your foot on the gas pedal and hold on. The load of the barbell is light enough that you should push to maintain unbroken sets for all 3 rounds. Remember to stand up completely on top of the box in the box jumps. For reps:
* **Freestanding Shoulder Taps in Handstand**: 3 minutes
* **Legless Rope Climbs (15 ft)**: 3 minutes
* **Freestanding Shoulder Taps in Handstand**: 2 minutes
* **Legless Rope Climbs**: 2 minutes
* **Freestanding Shoulder Taps in Handstand**: 1 minute
* **Legless Rope Climbs**: 1 minute
section_notes: Focus on finding a point of balance in the handstand before beginning taps.
Scale rope climbs to allow at least 1 rep every 20-30 seconds.

metadata.raw_content:
For reps:  
3 minutes of freestanding shoulder taps in a [handstand](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/freestanding-handstand)  
3 minutes of [legless rope climbs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-legless-rope-climb) (15 feet)  
2 minutes of freestanding shoulder taps in a handstand  
2 minutes of legless rope climbs  
1 minute of freestanding shoulder taps in a handstand  
1 minute of legless rope climbs

Post reps to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/240207).

**Scaling:**  
Time to get gymnasty. The goal of the freestanding shoulder taps is to reach a point of balance in a handstand and begin the shoulder taps. A rep is counted every time a hand touches a shoulder. Challenge yourself to reach balance before beginning the shoulder taps rather than wildly throwing your feet in the air and frantically looking for a shoulder to tap. If you struggle to find a point of balance freestanding, you are better off practicing against the wall. Performing shoulder taps with your stomach facing the wall will be easier than performing shoulder taps with your back to the wall. Scale the difficulty of the rope climbs to allow yourself at least 1 rep every 20-30 seconds.

**Intermediate option:**  
For reps:  
3 minutes of shoulder taps in a **handstand against the wall**  
3 minutes of [rope climbs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-wrapping) (15 feet)  
2 minutes of shoulder taps in a **handstand against the wall**  
2 minutes of **rope climbs**  
1 minute of shoulder taps in a **handstand against the wall**  
1 minute of **rope climbs**

**Beginner option:**  
For reps:  
3 minutes of shoulder taps in a **pike position on the floor**  
3 minutes of **pull-to-stands**  
2 minutes of shoulder taps in a **pike position on the floor**  
2 minutes of **pull-to-stands**  
1 minute of shoulder taps in a **pike position on the floor**  
1 minute of **pull-to-stands**

**Resources:**  
[The Freestanding Handstand](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/freestanding-handstand)  
[The Legless Rope Climb](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-legless-rope-climb)  
[The Rope Climb (Wrapping)](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-wrapping)  
[The Rope Climb (Basket)](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-basket)  
[Master the Movement: Handstands](https://games.crossfit.com/article/master-movement-handstands)

metadata.raw_content:
For time:  
15-12-9 reps of:  
[Back squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-back-squat?utm_source=owned&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=mswod)  
30-24-18 reps of:  
[Ring dips](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ring-dip?utm_source=owned&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=mswod)

♀ 155 lb  
♂ 225 lb

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/240209).

**Scaling:**  
Today’s couplet incorporates a heavy barbell and a gymnastics movement. If you have a rack, use it. If not, use a load that allows you to take the barbell from the ground and safely transition it to the back rack or change the movement to a front squat. The load of the barbell should be moderately heavy, however, once the barbell is on your back, you should be able to grind through each set unbroken. As long as you can maintain consistent sets of 5 ring dips, perform the prescribed number of reps.

**Intermediate option:**

section_notes: The challenge is consistency, not hitting a single PR.

metadata.raw_content:

[Row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing?utm_source=owned&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=mswod) 2,000 meters  
Rest 4:00 between efforts.

Post fastest and slowest times to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/240213#comments).

**Scaling:**  
If the single worst thing to do on the rower is a 2K effort, doing it three times must be something out of a horror film. Don’t worry, everything is going to be OK. The goal is not to hit a personal record on your 2K; the challenge in this workout is consistency. Experienced athletes should push to be within 5-10% of their PR for all 3 sets. Beginner athletes should start off conservatively and increase the pace as they are able.

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/240226#comments).

**Scaling:**  
Today’s chipper-style workout should be treated like a sprint. Complete each movement in as few sets as possible. The load of the barbell is moderate, however, the deadlift will feel much lighter than the front squats. Athletes using the prescribed weight should be able to perform at least 10 reps at a time. Go unbroken on the deadlifts if you can — this will really spice things up. Grind through as many front squats as possible because the more you drop it, the more you’ll have to pick it up again. Stick to a number of toes-to-bars that allows you to rest minimally between sets. Consider consistent sets of 5-10 reps with 10-15 seconds of rest between each set.
